title: STRENGTH FOR
THE CLIMB
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: bright midday sun hitting a clean wooden desk
dust motes dancing in a shaft of midday light
blurred view of a mountain range at high noon
close up of a vintage hourglass on a stone ledge
open field under a vast cloudless blue sky
gentle ripples on a sunlit creek

scenes.a: That recurring uncertainty about your capacity to handle the current challenge weighs on you today.
As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me.
As my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
scenes.sub: EVEN SO IS MY STRENGTH NOW

scenes.a: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day.
If so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.
Lord, grant us that same confidence to face what lies ahead, knowing you are our strength.
